code:
$ git checkout -b release/2.4.0 develop
# ...bug fixes only...
$ git checkout main
$ git merge release/2.4.0
$ git tag v2.4.0
$ git checkout develop
$ git merge release/2.4.0
caption: A release branch stabilizes, then merges into both main and develop.

code:
$ git checkout -b add-retry-logic main
# ...small, focused change...
$ git push origin add-retry-logic
# PR, review, merge same-day
$ git branch -d add-retry-logic
caption: One long-lived branch. Everything else merges back within a day or two.
